init.title: Azure Standard — Product tracking
init.description: Select which products you want to track with dedicated sensors. Only products ordered at least the minimum number of times appear as candidates.

data.min_purchase_count: Minimum order count to show as candidate

user.title: Azure Standard — Setup
user.description: Choose how to connect Azure Standard. **Manual** requires only your Drop ID (no account needed). **Account login** unlocks order history, shopping lists, and smart product sensors.

manual.title: Manual mode — Enter Drop ID
manual.description: Find your Drop ID at https://api.azurestandard.com/drops by matching name/location.

account.title: Account login
account.description: Enter your Azure Standard account credentials. Your password is used only once to obtain a session token.

drop_confirm.title: Confirm your drop location
drop_confirm.description: Detected drop: **{drop_name}** (ID: {drop_id}). You may override the Drop ID below if needed.

data.drop_id: Drop ID (leave blank to use detected)

error.invalid_drop_id: The Drop ID could not be found. Please verify it at https://api.azurestandard.com/drops.
error.missing_drop_id: A Drop ID is required. Please enter one manually.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Azure Standard API. Check your network and try again.
